name: subtrack
title: Subtrack
description: Track subscriptions, upcoming renewals, and monthly spend without leaving Raycast
author: nazozokc

commands.name: subscriptions
commands.title: Subscriptions
commands.description: Browse and filter every subscription you pay for

commands.name: upcoming
commands.title: Upcoming Renewals
commands.description: See what is about to be charged, and when

commands.name: summary
commands.title: Monthly Spend
commands.description: Total monthly cost broken down by currency and tag

commands.name: budget
commands.title: Budget
commands.description: Compare spending against your configured budget

commands.name: edit-subscription
commands.title: Edit Subscription
commands.description: Change the details of an existing subscription

preferences.name: binaryPath
preferences.title: subtrack binary
preferences.description: Path to the subtrack executable. Leave empty to search your PATH.

preferences.name: dbDir
preferences.title: Database directory
preferences.description: Overrides where subtrack reads its database. Leave empty to use the default.

preferences.name: defaultCurrency
preferences.title: Display currency
preferences.description: Convert all prices to this currency. Leave unset to keep original currencies.

ai.instructions: subtrack tracks the user's subscriptions and recurring spending. Read with list_subscriptions, get_summary, get_upcoming, or get_budget before changing anything. Amounts are in major currency units (11.99 means $11.99, not cents). Confirm with the user before any tool that adds, edits, or deletes a subscription.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
